title: Governor + votes token (OpenZeppelin)
description: An OpenZeppelin v5.7.0 ERC-20 votes token (fixed supply minted to the owner address) and a Governor with simple counting, a 4% quorum, a 1 day voting delay and a 1 week voting period. Both use a timestamp clock, so the timings do not depend on block times. No timelock: proposals execute from the Governor itself.
